title: Fix vendor contact relation read permission
summary: Vendor changes made through indirect permissions no longer fail when the contact update check reads Contact Business Relation. VendCont-Update now elevates read permission on that table, and CustCont-Update and BankCont-Update get the same small edit.
key_points: VendCont-Update now has read permission on Contact Business Relation
Fixes vendor modification failing for users with only indirect Vendor permissions
CustCont-Update and BankCont-Update are also modified with the same small edit
Users need no extra direct permissions; the contact synchronization logic itself is unchanged
No automated test added; modeled on the existing CustVendBank-Update permission pattern
